device.model: SPD3303 series programmable DC power supply
device.name: Siglent SPD3303 series power supply (instro.psu.drivers.siglent_spd3303.SiglentSPD3303)

facts.text: set_voltage writes CH{channel}:VOLT with three decimals and get_voltage queries MEAS:VOLT? for that channel
set_current_limit writes CH{channel}:CURR with three decimals and get_current queries MEAS:CURR? for that channel
get_voltage_setpoint and get_current_setpoint query CH{channel}:VOLT? and CH{channel}:CURR?
output_enable writes OUTP CH{channel},ON or OUTP CH{channel},OFF
get_output_status returns the ch{channel}_enable entry of the query_status() dictionary
query_status decodes the SYST:STAT? status word with masks 1 and 2 for the channel CC/CV mode, bits 2-3 for the PSU tracking mode and masks 16 and 32 for the channel enables
Only channels 1 and 2 are programmable; channel 3 is selectable via the front panel and does not expose a programming interface
The PSU driver contract documents voltages in volts and currents in amperes
SiglentSPD3303 composes a VisaDriver in __init__ and open()/close() open and close that transport
Every checked write and query reads SYST:ERR? afterwards and raises RuntimeError on a non-zero error reply
